en.body:
## From 'Game of Thrones' Extra to Crypto Kingpin

Anthony Boyle, an actor whose early career included a memorable turn on **Game of Thrones**, is taking on one of the most talked-about figures in recent financial history. He's set to embody **Sam Bankman-Fried**, the enigmatic founder of the cryptocurrency exchange FTX, in Netflix's ambitious miniseries, **The Altruists**. The show aims to dissect the meteoric rise and spectacular collapse of Bankman-Fried's empire, a saga that captivated and shocked the world. Boyle, who has previously stated he's "played more real people than not," steps into the bushy-haired shoes of the former billionaire, promising a nuanced portrayal of a man who became both a tech wunderkind and a cautionary tale.

Joining Boyle is **Julia Garner**, who will star as **Caroline Ellison**, Bankman-Fried's business partner and a key figure in the FTX drama. The series is helmed by executive producers **Barack and Michelle Obama**, adding a significant layer of prestige to the project. Details emerging suggest **The Altruists** will not shy away from the complex ethical questions and the volatile nature of the cryptocurrency market that defined Bankman-Fried's tenure. The narrative is poised to explore the ambition, innovation, and eventual downfall that led to one of the biggest financial implosions in recent memory.

## The 'Altruists' Phenomenon and Fan Anticipation

The story of Sam Bankman-Fried has proven irresistible to storytellers, with **The Altruists** being the latest high-profile adaptation. This Netflix miniseries follows in the wake of other creative interpretations, including the stage production "Luigi: The Musical," which also focused on Bankman-Fried's post-collapse experiences. The sheer public fascination with the FTX saga, its intricate web of finance, and the larger-than-life personalities involved has created a significant appetite for these screen adaptations. Fans are eager to see how **The Altruists** will tackle the nuances of Bankman-Fried's story, particularly his public image as a supposed altruist versus the reality of his alleged financial misdeeds. The involvement of **Julia Garner** and the **Obamas** as executive producers has only amplified the anticipation, suggesting a production that prioritizes depth and critical examination over sensationalism.

## What's Next for 'The Altruists'

Netflix has slated **The Altruists** for release on November 19, 2026. While specific details about the full cast and directorial team beyond the executive producers have not yet been announced, the confirmed stars and the subject matter suggest a must-watch event for fans of gripping true-crime dramas and complex financial narratives.
